g.text: Orchestrates batch payment processing, settlement, and reconciliation.
Produces settlement files and pushes them to the acquiring network.
Metrics, logs, and traces for the batch pipeline.
Public REST API that accepts batch submissions,
validates them, and enforces idempotency keys so
Splits a batch into per-recipient jobs, schedules
them, retries transient failures with backoff, and
Double-entry ledger of record for every debit and
credit; the single source of truth for balances.
Deprecated SOAP gateway kept only for two enterprise
clients that have not migrated to the new API yet.
Short-lived store of idempotency keys and in-flight
Renders ISO-20022 and proprietary settlement files
External card/acquiring network that settles the
Scrapes batch engine and API metrics. (Prometheus)
Operator dashboards for batch throughput, failure
